name: Wall Tibialis Raise
description: Strengthens the muscle on the front of the shin: leaning back against a wall with your heels out in front, lift your toes as high as you can, then lower.

source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with your upper back flat against a wall.
Walk your heels about 30 cm (12 in) out in front of you.
cues: Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Hold for a second, then lower with control.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Lean on the wall
keyframes.cue: Upper back on the wall, heels forward.

keyframes.name: Toes up
keyframes.cue: Lift your toes and the front of your feet.
